common.tagline: Lock your natively staked SOL with a second key you control, so a stolen wallet key cannot withdraw it.
common.comingSoonBody: Coming soon: this page is not ready yet.
common.notFoundBody: There is no page at this address.
common.neverSeedPhrase: Stakeward never asks for your seed phrase.
common.cannotMoveSol: This transaction cannot move your SOL.

landing.title: Protect your staked SOL
landing.body: Stakeward puts a lock on your existing stake accounts. While the lock holds, the stake can only be withdrawn or moved to a new owner when your second key co-signs.
landing.cannotDo1: It cannot protect liquid staking tokens, stake held on exchanges or SOL in your wallet balance.
landing.cannotDo2: It cannot stop someone with your main key from deactivating or redelegating the stake; they still cannot take it.
landing.cannotDo3: Whoever holds the second key can freeze the stake by moving the lock date. Guard the second key as carefully as the main one.
landing.cannotDo4: It never holds your funds and never sees your keys or seed phrase.

status.protectedHint: Withdrawing or changing the owner needs your second key until {date}.
status.expiringHint: The lock ends on {date}. Extend it to stay protected.
status.unprotectedHint: Anyone with your main key can withdraw this stake.
status.lockedByOtherHint: The second key is {address}. Connect it if it is yours.
status.secondKeyNotConnectedHint: Connect your second key to manage this lock.
status.managedByService: A staking service may manage this stake.

status.wasProtectedHint: This stake was protected, but its lock has ended. Anyone with your main key can withdraw it now. Protect it again.
status.unknownHint: Could not read this stake account from the network.

address.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.
address.explorer: View {address} on Solana Explorer (opens in a new tab)

accountRow.label: Stake account {address}
accountRow.managedByServiceDetail: With a lock, the service may fail to rebalance or merge it. Check with the service before you protect it.
accountRow.loadError: Check your connection, then try again.

walletSlot.noWallets: No Solana wallet found in this browser. Install a wallet such as Phantom, Solflare or Backpack, then reload this page.

switch.main: Switch to your main account in the wallet, then press Continue.
switch.second: Switch to your second account in the wallet, then press Continue.
switch.new: Switch to your new wallet's account in the wallet, then press Continue.

kind.rescue: Move this stake to your new wallet

tx.intro: Read from the exact transaction your wallet is about to sign. Check every line before you sign.
tx.deactivating: Deactivating: stops earning at the end of this epoch

cannot.changeOwner: It cannot change who can withdraw: only the lock and its second key change.
cannot.onlyDate: It only changes the date the lock ends.
cannot.onlyRecipient: It can only send SOL to the address shown above.
cannot.noKeyChange: It does not change any key or the lock.
cannot.keepsLock: It does not change the lock.
cannot.rescueNoMove: It cannot move your SOL out of the stake account: only its keys change.
cannot.stakeStays: This transaction cannot move your SOL: it stays in the stake account.
cannot.noStake: It cannot touch your stake accounts.

tx.blockhash: About one minute after it was created. If it expires, start signing again.
tx.nonce: Until it is sent or cancelled. It uses this link-signing account:
tx.lighthouse: Checks your wallet added at the end (Lighthouse): {count}. They only read accounts and cannot move funds.

warn.replacesSecondKey: This replaces the current second key:
warn.shortens: This makes the lock end sooner: on {date} instead of {current}.
warn.recipientNotSigner: The SOL goes to a wallet that does not sign this transaction. Make sure this address is yours:

tx.rejectedBody: Stakeward shows only transactions it can fully read, and it cannot read this one.

rejected.malformed: This is not a valid transaction.
rejected.unsupported-version: This transaction uses a format Stakeward never builds.
rejected.address-lookup-table: This transaction uses address lookup tables, which Stakeward never uses.
rejected.unknown-program: This transaction calls a program Stakeward never uses.
rejected.unknown-instruction: This transaction contains an instruction Stakeward never builds.
rejected.bad-layout: This transaction is not in the format Stakeward builds.
rejected.multiple-stake-accounts: This transaction touches more than one stake account.
rejected.bad-lighthouse-tail: A wallet changed this transaction in a way Stakeward does not accept.
rejected.invalid-signature: A signature on this transaction is not valid.
rejected.verification-unavailable: This browser cannot check the signatures on this transaction. Open it in a current browser.

risk.loseSecondKey: If you lose the second key, you wait until {date} to withdraw or rescue this stake.
risk.secondKeyCanFreeze: Whoever holds the second key can freeze this stake by moving the lock date. Keep it as safe as your main key.
risk.withdrawCompromised: If your main key may be compromised, do not withdraw to it. Use Rescue.
risk.unlockOpensWindow: After the lock is removed, anyone with your main key can withdraw this stake right away.
risk.lockEnds: On {date} the lock ends and anyone with your main key can withdraw this stake. Extend it before then.

empty.nativeStake: Stakeward protects native stake: SOL you delegated to a validator from your own wallet, held in a stake account that your keys control.
empty.notStake: Liquid staking tokens (LSTs), stake on an exchange and SOL in your wallet balance are not stake accounts, so there is nothing here to lock.
empty.checkMainKey: If you do stake from a wallet, enter the address of its main key: the wallet that can withdraw the stake.

devUi.title: Design system
devUi.intro: Every design token and every product component in every state. This page exists only on devnet.
devUi.coloursNote: Both themes, whatever this browser uses. Values come from tokens.css.
devUi.sansSample: Geist: Stakeward never asks for your seed phrase.
devUi.spacingNote: One unit is {unit}. Classes such as p-4 and gap-2 are multiples of it.
devUi.alertBody: Alert text says what happened and what to do next.
devUi.inputInvalidHint: Check the address: it should be 32 to 44 letters and digits.
devUi.checkboxLabel: My second key comes from a different seed phrase
devUi.tooltipTrigger: Hover or focus for a tooltip
devUi.tooltipText: Tooltips repeat information that is also on the page.

sample.connectionLost: The wallet did not answer. Check that it is unlocked, then try again.

errors.lockup-in-force: Locked until {date}: your second key must co-sign.
errors.lockup-in-force-no-date: This stake is locked: your second key must co-sign.
errors.custodian-missing: This change needs your second key too: it must co-sign before you send.
errors.custodian-signature-missing: Your second key is part of this transaction but did not sign. Ask it to sign, then send again.
errors.already-deactivated: This stake is already deactivated. Refresh to see its current state.
errors.too-soon-to-redelegate: This stake is still deactivating. Delegate it again after the current epoch ends.
errors.insufficient-delegation: This stake holds less than the 1 SOL minimum the network allows to delegate.
errors.merge-mismatch: These stake accounts cannot be combined: their keys or locks differ.
errors.missing-signature: A key that must sign did not, or it no longer controls this stake. Check the connected wallets and try again.
errors.insufficient-funds: There is not enough SOL for this. If the stake is still deactivating, wait until the epoch ends; if the wallet paying the fee is empty, add a little SOL to it. Then try again.
errors.blockhash-expired: This transaction expired before it reached the network. Sign it again.
errors.nonce-advanced: This signing link is no longer valid: it was used or cancelled. Start again to get a new one.
errors.already-processed: This transaction already went through. Refresh to see the current state.
errors.wallet-rejected: The request was declined in the wallet. Nothing was sent; you can try again.
errors.network: The Solana network did not respond. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Refresh to see the current state, then try again.
